_comment: Story files for the Slow Rooms folder: recordings, transcripts, logs. Audio files use kind:audio and a generated WAV under filesystem/assets. The confession excerpt and full transcript are hidden until decrypted from the encrypted archive (see terminal/secrets.json).

files.body:
SLOW ROOMS — working folder
===========================

Production sound for the Harbourlight documentary. Everything in here is covered by the participant agreement and the Oakmount consent protocol. Do not share resident recordings. I mean it, future me.

Folders:
  /recordings   - session WAVs, named DATE_INITIALS_NN.wav
  /transcripts  - my transcripts. I do these by hand. No cloud transcription of resident material.
  /logs         - session logs: who, when, how they seemed, whether they asked to stop
  /ambience     - the room-tone library (the part I get to sell)
  /AMB_MASTER   - delivered to the office Aug 28. don't touch.

The AF_03 material from May 14 is NOT in this folder anymore. It's in the encrypted archive on the desktop (see the note in there). If you're reading this and you're not me: the reason it's locked is in the letter in my inbox. The reason it's not deleted is that some things you don't get to delete.

- W

SLOW ROOMS — SESSION LOG — week of 2026-05-11
Recordist: W. Castellanos. Kit: MixPre-6 II, MKH 8040 ORTF, DPA 4060 lav for interviews.

---
2026-05-12  Rm 22  Mrs. E. Beazley (SDM: daughter, consent on file)
  Present: Wren, Ilse (cam), care aide (Sandra).
  14:02 start. Talking about her garden in Kentville. Lovely.
  14:16 she said 'I think that's enough dear'. STOPPED immediately per protocol. She was fine, wanted tea. Noted for Deborah.
  Usable: 0-14:00, lovely stuff about lupins.

---
2026-05-13  East wing corridor  ambience only, no residents
  23:10-00:40. The hum again. Strongest outside 17-19. Recorded from 3 positions. Files RT_corridor_A/B/C.
  Note: it moves. I know rooms don't do that. Forum says ducts. Fine.

---
2026-05-14  Rm 17  A. Furey (SDM: son Derek Furey, consent on file)
  Present: Wren only (Ilse off, Alden calmer 1:1).
  20:30 start. Good day for him, lucid at first. Dock strike 1971, the tugs, his wife Bernadette (deceased — he knows sometimes, not others).
  ~40:00 he changed. Thought I was someone else. Used a name — 'Colleen'? — and started talking to me as if I were her, or as if she were in the room. I did NOT prompt (Paul's rule). I let it run.
  What he said in that stretch is not for this log. It's a disclosure of a serious historical crime. I stopped the interview at 44:30 when he got distressed and called the aide. He settled. Asked if the tide was in.
  ACTION: told Nadia. Do NOT circulate AF_03. Meeting Monday with Colin + Kavanagh (consultant, ret. RCMP).
  I sat in the van for a while after. Writing this at home. I can't stop hearing the ring part.

---
2026-05-15  no sessions. wrote the transcript instead. didn't sleep.

AF_01 — 2026-03-14 — Rm 17, A. Furey. Transcript by W.C.
[timecodes approximate]

00:12  AF: You'll want to sit where you can see the door. Always sit where you can see the door.
00:20  WC: I will. Can you tell me about the boats?
00:24  AF: Which boats. There's forty years of boats.
00:31  AF: I bought the first one off a fella named Doucette. Gerry. We were friends then. [pause] We were friends a long time actually. On and off.
01:10  AF: You load salt in February, your hands stop being hands. They're just... hooks. You get the boat in, you get the lines, and somebody's wife has the kettle on and that's the whole of it. That's the whole of a life, if you're lucky.
02:40  AF: Is Bernadette in yet? She said she'd bring the good coffee.
02:46  WC: Not yet.
02:49  AF: She's always late. Fifty years late. [laughs] Don't tell her I said.

[continues — dock strike, the Bluenose, his son Derek 'who runs it all now and won't listen'. Nothing flagged. Good session. He was happy.]
